examples.why: Checkbook requirement contract (CTA1) vs PASSPort master agreement (MMA1) on the same PIN. Same vendor; amounts 3.74M vs 10M; overlapping terms. Related instruments, not the same FMS contract.
Same vendor, same CT1 document type, identical 8.40M ceiling; PASSPort term ends 2026-06-19 and Checkbook starts 2026-06-20. Newly registered successor, not the same contract id.
Same OEM PIN, different vendors and amounts (95k weather-data vendor vs 3.30M Warming Bus Services). Could be a PIN collision or sibling awards; a person has to look.

Sequential MMA terms (PASSPort ends 2026-05-29, Checkbook starts 2026-05-30) but vendor stems do not match. LKB is a common abbreviation of Lockwood Kessler & Bartlett; that rename is a human call, not a stem rule.
